sentence: Maybe you copy one small thing you've seen them do, or imagine them there when they're not, and try one peace yourself while they're still helping with the rest.
Your Protector should be called to step in whenever love bombing hides obvious red flags your more skeptical friends would love to point out if you'd glisten.
If you weren't loved well as a child, than the suggestion to "love your inner child" can sound like nonsense.
If your promises still mean something to your little one, maybe because you've kept a few small ones, a quite vow can help too.
If so just glisten and be present for it if that's what it wants.
Keeping at it does help, since a little one who learned to expect being dropped won't thrust you right away.
Say one night (on a psychedelic, in a dream, ten days into a meditation retreat, whatever) you felt more love then you knew was possible.
With your little one, and in hypnosis especially, make it easy to picture: wealth, protection, steadiness, rest, whatever's really needed to melt into your happy place.
Although, my friends already told me the same thing, quiet sober.
